notes.title: Latest Update
notes.content:
This Update contains multiple changes to Antenna’s Programming and compilation aimed at enhanced performance in reducing memory consumption dramatically and generalised improvements to the game code itself.

New Features have also been added:
[list]
    [*]Remap the “?” key from the in-game menu
    [*]Auto-Save Checkpoints (allowing you to return to the game where you left off if you haven’t completed the game)
[/list] 

A new User Guide is available from the store page and inside the installation folder, we have also compiled the game into a single file “antenna.exe”.

Please report any issues you come across to operator@lwna.net

Thanks

notes.title: Patch Released
notes.content:
A new patch for Antenna has been released, along with it a basic user manual and updates to the System Requirements.

changes include:

[list]
[*] Shortened Intro
[*] New Framework/Runtime
[*] Bug Fix on the Doorcode ** see note below 
[*] Full Screen Toggle
[*] Many minor adjustments to improve performance 
[/list]

** Note, The conditions to clear the doorcode puzzle have slightly changed, set your positions and if correct when the last tone plays the puzzle will clear. 

The Original Version of Antenna is still available by opting into it as a beta. This can be accessed by Right Clicking on Antenna in your library and Selecting Properties, then in the "Betas" tab you can select "beta" from the drop list to download the original version of Antenna.

For Support Email:
operator@lwna.net

notes.title: Upcoming Patch Information
notes.content:
We are currently working to deliver the following changes, improvements and bug fixes in an upcoming patch. Thank you for all the feedback in the discussions and reviews.

Below is a quick overview of what is being addressed in the upcoming patch. After testing is complete we will update the community with more details and an estimated release date.
 
[list]
[*] [b]Bug[/b] - “4 dong puzzle” Infinite Sliders Glitch + code adjustments
[*] [b]Bug[/b] - Loading on secondary monitor issue
[*] [b]Bug[/b] - Memory leak after the GTYUHB Puzzle that results in crash on some systems
[*] [b]Change[/b] - Upgraded framework with improved memory handling and general performance
[*] [b]Change[/b] - Steam API upgrade from 1.30 to 1.36
[*] [b]Addition[/b] - Toggle Window/Fullscreen (to allow you to drag from monitor to monitor)
[*] [b]Addition[/b] - Error reports generated in Game Folder for quick debugging
[*] [b]Change/Addition[/b] - To Hold or Press Key indication added to GUI
[*] [b]Change[/b] - Static Title Screen
[*] [b]Addition[/b] - Skippable intro
[*] [b]Store Page[/b] - Basic user manual + minor changes to page information

[/list]

[b]For players crashing on launch and during game[/b]
We are running a private beta through steam and soon we will be inviting interested players effected by either of these crashes to register for participation. More details soon.

Thank You
